meta.description: Lightweight lead list for the Nigeria-market DM outreach track (businesses with no storefront to audit, sold via Instagram/TikTok DM). Kept separate from targets_pool.json, whose schema assumes every target has a url worth auditing. Sourced via BrowserAct (see CLAUDE.md 'BrowserAct Data API'). See docs/koolestpro-growth-operating-plan.md for the Nigeria/Africa track this feeds.

recordSchema.category: string, free text business category (not the Shopify/DTC categories from targets_pool.json)
recordSchema.rating: string, e.g. '4.7/5.0', or null if not captured
recordSchema.avgPricePerPerson: string or null, currency-agnostic range as scraped
recordSchema.instagramHandle: string or null - NOT provided by the Google Maps scraper, needs manual lookup before DM outreach is possible
recordSchema.phone: string or null - same gap as above
recordSchema.segment: nigeria-dm (fixed for this file, matches the growth plan's Nigeria/Africa track)
recordSchema.contactMethod: instagram-dm | whatsapp | other - set once a real handle/number is found
recordSchema.status: Available | NeedsContactInfo | Contacted | Replied | Converted | Rejected
recordSchema.leadPotential: High | Medium | Low | Unrated - simple heuristic on rating+reviewCount, not a substitute for a human look

knownGaps: Google Maps Scraper template returns no website, Instagram handle, or phone number - every lead here needs a manual/secondary lookup step before it's actually DM-able. Status starts at 'NeedsContactInfo' for that reason, not 'Available'.
leadPotential is a placeholder heuristic (rating >= 4.5 and reviewCount >= 15 => Medium, higher volume => High) - not validated against real conversion data yet.
